subject: [PATCH v5 1/8] mm/gup: break out gup_fill_pages() helper

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch breaks out a helper function called `gup_fill_pages()` from the `__get_user_pages()` function in the Linux kernel's memory management code. The new helper function is responsible for storing consecutive pages into an array, and it is shared by both the slow and fast paths of the GUP (Get User Pages) operation. This change simplifies the code and reduces duplication, but does not introduce any functional changes. The patch also keeps a `pages==NULL` check in the helper function to handle cases where no pages array is passed.
